01 / Who we are

Spicy ideas.
Serious engineering.

[ Us ]

A team that builds.

Peppers is a student-and-alumni STEM community from Liceul Teoretic de Informatică “Grigore Moisil” in Iași. Mechanical design, electronics, software, and outreach all happen in one workshop.

[ Mission ]

Bring the heat. Share it.

We give students room to design, build, break, and rebuild real machines. Then we share what we learn through education, mentoring, and community projects.

[ FTC ]

What is FIRST Tech Challenge?

An international robotics competition for students aged 12–18. Each season starts with a new game. Teams design, build, and program a robot to play it, then compete in alliances at regional, national, and world events.

03 / Beyond the robot

Projects &
awards.

What the team does between matches: the programs we run, and what we’ve brought home.

  • Education

    Peppers STEM Special

    Hands-on STEM demos for younger students.

  • Community

    Dăruiește un robot

    Robotics, electronics, and programming lessons for under-resourced schools.

  • Inclusion

    RoboReach

    STEM outreach for students with disabilities.

  • Education

    LIIS STEM Junior

    Arduino lessons for middle-school students.

  • Training

    House of Rookies

    Recruitment and first training for new team members.

  • Training

    PeppQuest

    CAD, mechanics, and programming training, finished with an Arduino build challenge.

  • Media

    PeppTalks

    Interviews with students and mentors.

  • Just for fun

    PeppStrike

    A Counter-Strike 2 tournament for Romanian FTC teams.

  • Event

    AI vs Human Art

    An event exploring technology, creativity, and AI.

A few things
to know.

Information about the team, visits, and supporting our work.

Email Peppers ↗
How does recruitment work? +

We recruit at school only. Recruitment information is shared in school.

Can I visit or see a robot? +

Open shop days and community activities are opportunities to meet us. Check the event listings for visit information and confirmed arrangements before making plans.

Browse upcoming events ↗
How can I support Peppers? +

Funding, components, fabrication, workshop space, and equipment can all help students keep building.

Write to contact@peppers-robotics.ro to discuss how you would like to support the team.

Contact the team ↗
What about mentoring? +

Sharing practical experience can help students work through design, electronics, programming, and communication challenges.

Tell us about your experience and how you would like to help at contact@peppers-robotics.ro.

Contact the team ↗

We’re FTC Team 19044 from Iași, Romania, based at Liceul Teoretic de Informatică “Grigore Moisil”.

PEPPERS19044

More than robots.
We’re building tomorrow.

Peppers Robotics is a student-and-alumni STEM community and FIRST Tech Challenge team from Iași, Romania, based at Liceul Teoretic de Informatică “Grigore Moisil”.

Mechanical design, electronics, software, and outreach come together in our workshop. Beyond competition, we share robotics through education, mentoring, and community activities.
